candidate_evidence.quote: [OTHER] Home Health Encounter (other names: HH, Home, Home Care Visit, Home Health): Receive at-home treatment
Patients receive at least 1 cycle of their standard of care (SOC) treatment regimen in the clinic in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: At-Home Cancer Directed Therapy Versus in Clinic for the Treatment of Patients With Advanced Cancer

coder_notes: Care-delivery trial (home vs clinic administration of each patient's own SOC regimen). No drug is a registered intervention and no single drug is given to every patient; the long list of permitted SOC regimens (incl. bevacizumab + temozolomide/lomustine for glioblastoma) is an eligibility list, so no agents are listed. Arm B (clinic first) works as the standard-administration control though labelled EXPERIMENTAL. 'Advanced' mapped to recurrent per C10; setting is really unrestricted.
